responsibility: This file is the main implementation of GCC’s pass execution infrastructure. It defines current_pass tracking, default opt_pass behavior, selected pass_manager helpers, the machinery for running pass lists over functions or IPA stages, property verification and dump/timing integration, and helper entry points used during declaration compilation, summary reading, IPA stmt fixups, and debugging of pass properties. Its responsibility is orchestration of the instantiated pass tree at compile time rather than enumerating the pipeline structure itself.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/passes.def, which declaratively lists the pass pipeline with NEXT_PASS-style macros, this .cc file implements the pass-manager runtime machinery that instantiates, executes, times, and coordinates those passes and their hooks.
